The Bioware Community Live Team presents: 

'Neverwinter Nights: Infinite Dungeons' v 1.0 

Designed by:
  Peter Thomas
  Jason 'Elidrin' Lowry
  Grant Mackay
  Dan Whiteside
  Cori May
  Jonathan Epp
  Rob Bartel

Starting Level: 1-40 (5-30 recommended)
Number of Players: 1-4 recommended

You've journeyed to Waterdeep to explore Undermountain, the most famous dungeon in all of the Forgotten Realms. According to the legends, there's treasure to be won, puzzles to be solved, and a mystery that will lead you ever deeper... But the legends never told you how deep it truly went.

Infinite Dungeons provides randomly generated adventures for players of every level. Play with your friends or compete against your adversaries. If you dare, you can play alone. In the end, it all comes down to one question: Are you brave enough?
